description: Covers B19, B22, B23. A WinEvent hook (EVENT_OBJECT_SHOW, pumped on the guard thread) hides a window a DLL opens after start-up at once instead of within a sweep (B19); display_guard.h IsOwnMove recognises the logical rect at a scaled target DPI, or logs and re-places once (B22); headless.cpp rewrites headless_status.json after each verified relocation (B23).
title: Headless display guard: show-time hook, scaled-DPI own moves, status after relocation
